mechanism_narrative: A low and stable federal funds rate (below 2.0%) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 2.0% in a single month, it signals a tightening cycle that increases discount rates and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises above 2.0% in a month, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) indicates weak household demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a rising labor force participation rate (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) signals tight labor market conditions that drive inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, the 20-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS rises by more than 0.5% monthly, or the Rank IC for the PAYEMS signal in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 in a single month, it signals an immediate manufacturing slowdown that causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO falls below 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong GDP growth (GDPC1) above 3.0% annualized in the previous quarter signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 50% of periods when GDPC1 growth is above 3.0% annualized, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% year-over-year, it triggers a Fed response that increases real rates and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return is positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.
